Master of Statistics and Data Science - ICP Connect

Provider: VLIR-UOS

Degree: Initial Master (2 years)

Field of study: Statistics and Data Science

Funding Type: VLIR-UOS ICP Connect scholarships cover tuition fees, travel, insurance and living expenses (board and lodging)

Eligible countries: Benin, Burkina Faso, Burundi, Cameroon

Country of study: Belgium

Eligibility criteria: Candidates must hold nationality from one of the 29 eligible countries and reside in any of these countries at the time of application. International applicants apply through the institution website.

Deadline: 1 February 2031
